what_happened: On a wet multi-lane highway with the command STRAIGHT (RIGHT at the last frame), the policy's path bent left. The ego drifted out of its lane into the adjacent left lane and hit actor 41 side-on, which was travelling alongside, at about 4.3 m/s. The lead vehicle stayed about 20 m ahead and was never involved.

After the policy took over at 4.6 s on a straight highway, the ego braked hard from about 16 to 8 m/s even though the gap to the car ahead was growing. At the same time it steered left, leaving the recorded straight path, and drove its front into actor 1 in the lane to its left. The hard braking also got the ego rear-ended.

On a multi-lane highway at about 17 m/s, the policy took over at 4.6 s. It then braked hard (down to 8.9 m/s) and steered left out of its lane, even though the recorded path stayed in the lane and the final command was RIGHT. Its front hit actor 1 in the adjacent left lane at 6.2 s. The hard braking also likely caused the rear contact from the car behind.

After handoff on a multi-lane highway, the ego braked hard (28.8 to 13.5 m/s) for no clear reason, which likely caused the earlier rear contact. It then drifted left off its lane and onto the left shoulder/median edge, about 5 m from the recorded path, even though the command was RIGHT and the planned route went right. At 7.8 s it was offroad and touching a vehicle that was passing on its right.

After the policy took over at 4.6s on a straight highway, the ego braked hard for no clear reason (17 → 8.7 m/s, with the lead about 20 m ahead and pulling away) and drifted left off the recorded path into the adjacent lane. Its front hit actor 1, which was beside it in that lane. The ego was also rear-ended, most likely by traffic behind it because of the sudden braking.

On a multi-lane highway, the ego braked hard from 29 to 13 m/s after handoff, which probably caused the earlier rear contact. Although the route command switched to RIGHT and the recorded path stayed to the right, it then steered left out of its lane onto the left shoulder/median and left the road at 7.7 s, about 5 m from the recorded path. Front contact with actor 40 was registered at the same moment it went off the road.

After handoff the policy's planned path (orange) kept drifting left even though the command was STRAIGHT and then RIGHT. The ego crossed the lane line into the left lane just as pickup 41 was passing it on that side, and its front hit the pickup at about 4 m/s.

The ego was about 6–7 m left of the recorded path, with the command RIGHT and actor 33 running right alongside it. As the road curved left, the ego held its heading and drifted right across its lane line, and its front corner hit actor 33.

The route said RIGHT and the recorded path moved right, but the policy kept the ego in the leftmost highway lane. It braked hard from 26 to 13 m/s, which likely caused the earlier rear-end hit, then drifted left over the edge line onto the shoulder at 8.2s.

The command was RIGHT, but the ego stayed on the far-left edge of the freeway beside the median barrier, about 6–7 m left of the recorded path, which ran a few lanes to the right. It held its heading and sped up from 6.3 to 7.1 m/s instead of moving right, and was flagged off-road along the left shoulder and barrier at 11.8s. There was no lead vehicle or collision involved.

The route command was RIGHT and the route bears right, but after handoff the policy drifted left out of its lane while slowing from 12 to 6.5 m/s. It crossed the leftmost lane line and drove onto the median island ahead of the intersection, about 7.3 m off the recorded human path. No other actor was nearby, and the camera view stayed clean until the ego was already on the median.
